Coram : VIKRAM NATH*, RAJESH BINDAL
HEADNOTES Issue for consideration: Whether the High Court was justifi ed in dismissing the application fi led by the appellant u/Or.VII r.11(d) CPC for rejection of the subsequent suit fi led by the respondent-owner for damages for use and occupation of of the lease period. Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 – Or. VII r. 11(d) – Application under – First suit fi led by the respondent for possession without claiming any damages for use and occupation – Subsequent suit fi led only for claiming damages for use and occupation
